used.text: Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_DM_01431] Support of SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ For each DiagnosticSovdData , the DMshall provide the SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity according to ASAM SOVD [5][14]. The write method is optional and is based on the presence of DiagnosticSovdData . DiagnosticSovdMethod.put . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02166] SOVD method Write a data resource from an Entity – data query Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ If the SOVD method Write a data resource is received, the DM shall call the corresponding GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Write method with the Diag- nosticSovdContentData data created with: • DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetName with the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentElement • DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::SetContent with the value derived from the conversation rules defined in Chapter 7.3.3.3.2 “SOVD Data – Conversion”. ⌋ 7.3.3.5.2 SOVD API – Configuration The ASAM SOVD[5] standard generally supports two different approaches for the API Methods for Configuration : • Configurations as parameter , using MIME type application/json with defined Response Body structure. • Configurations as bulk-data , using bulk like MIME types , such as application/octet-stream . For the realization of these SOVD API Methods for Configuration two different approaches have been realized: • Configurations as parameter derived from DiagnosticSovdContent under us- age of DiagnosticSovdConfigContentMapping . • Configurations as parameter or Configurations as bulk-data re- alized explicitly by modelling and using the dedicated ara::diag::SovdCon- figuration::SovdConfiguration Interface 206 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics

used.text: Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_DM_01429] SOVD method Retrieve List of All Configurations Provided by the Entity Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04261, RS_Diag_04258 ⌈ If at least one SOVD configuration is configured, the Diagnostic Server in- stance shall provide the SOVD method Retrieve List of All Configura- tions Provided by the Entity according to ASAM SOVD[5]. ⌋ 7.3.3.5.2.1 Configuration – Explicit Configurations [SWS_DM_01787] Realization of SOVD Read Configuration Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04261 ⌈ If the SOVD method Read Configuration is called for an explicitly modelled SOVD Configuration the Diagnostic Server instance shall call ara::diag::Sovd- Configuration::RequestGetConfiguration . ⌋ [SWS_DM_01788] Realization of SOVD Write Configuration Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04261 ⌈ If the SOVD method Write Configuration is called for an explicitly modelled SOVD Configuration the Diagnostic Server instance shall call ara::diag:: SovdConfiguration::RequestPutConfiguration . ⌋ 7.3.3.5.3 SOVD API – Data Lists [SWS_DM_01420] SOVD data-list Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260, RS_Diag_04258 ⌈ The Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD methods Retrieve List of All Data-Lists Provided by the Entity , Creating a Data List for Reading Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity , Read Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity Using a Data List and Delete an Existing Data List according ASAM SOVD[5]. ⌋ [SWS_DM_01419] SOVD method Read Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity Using a Data List Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04260 ⌈ The response body for SOVD method Read Multiple Data Values at Once from an Entity Using a Data List shall be queried analog to SOVD method Read Single Data Value from an Entity . ⌋ 207 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics
